title.narrative: "Sove Lavi, Asire Dinyite ak Sekirite Deplase yo" (Save Lives, Ensure Dignity and Safety for the Displaced)

description.narrative:
The "Sove Lavi, Asire Dinyite ak Sekirite Deplase yo" (Save Lives, Ensure Dignity and Safety for the Displaced) project is a seven-month humanitarian initiative by Christian Aid, in partnership with local organisation Haïti Survie. The project, which started in September 2025 and is set to finish in April 2026, aims to help 3,500 internally displaced persons (IDPs) in three formal displacement sites in Port-au-Prince. The total funding allocated to Haiti Survie for the project is €285,446.55. The project focuses on a multi-sectoral response to the needs of people displaced by gang violence, with a focus on food security, water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH), and essential non-food items (NFIs). Key activities include:
Cash Assistance: Two rounds of unconditional cash transfers will be given to 600 of the most vulnerable households. This is designed to help them meet their basic food and NFI needs. WASH Support: The project will provide over 200,000 litres of safe drinking water and over 200,000 litres of water for domestic use across the three sites. It will also distribute hygiene kits to 700 households and conduct insecticide spraying to reduce pest-related health risks. Shelter: To improve living conditions and offer protection from the weather, 150 tarpaulins will be installed for 700 IDPs who are living in exposed, open-air conditions.
The direct beneficiaries will be identified through a household-level vulnerability assessment. The selection process will prioritise female-headed households, families recently displaced by violence, and households with vulnerable individuals like children under five, pregnant women, older people, and people with disabilities. Christian Aid will work closely with its local partner, Haïti Survie, which has over 15 years of experience in humanitarian response in Port-au-Prince. Haïti Survie will manage a significant portion of the project budget and participate in all stages of the project, including planning and evaluation.
